events.name: THE DRAGON BALL HUNT: DENDE'S NEWS

steps.text: %s! I'm so glad you came!
Cooler has stolen all seven Dragon Balls and hidden them all around the world!
In the wrong hands their power could doom the Earth.
Please find all seven and bring them back here to me. You can fly - search everywhere! But you'll have to land to pick one up.
FIND THE 7 DRAGON BALLS!

events.name: THE DRAGON BALL HUNT: TALKING TO DENDE

steps.text: Keep looking, %s! The count is in the top right corner. Cooler hid them all over the world.
You've found all the Dragon Balls!
But there's no time to celebrate. There's a spaceship on the southern tip of Amenbo Island.
If you get in, it will take you to the Moon, where Cooler is hiding while he plans his secret attack: to destroy the Earth with a Supernova!
He's furious that you took the Dragon Balls back, and he wants revenge.
Please, %s, go and stop him before he destroys us all. Hurry!
FIND THE SPACESHIP ON THE SOUTHERN TIP OF AMENBO ISLAND!
The spaceship is on the southern tip of Amenbo Island. Hurry, %s - Cooler is waiting on the Moon!
%s! You did it - Cooler is beaten!
The whole Earth felt the battle on the Moon. We're all so grateful: you saved the planet from Cooler.
From this day on, you are recognized as the HERO OF EARTH!
YOU ARE THE HERO OF EARTH!
Thank you again, %s. The Earth will never forget its hero.

events.name: THE DRAGON BALL HUNT: COOLER BEATEN

steps.text: Cooler is beaten! Return to Dende at the Lookout.
COOLER IS BEATEN! GO BACK TO DENDE
